_readme: Copy to config.json. Keys starting with _ are comments. Restart the bridge after editing: firetvctl restart
_allowed_devices: Optional: list the Fire TV IPs on this job to lock the bridge to them, e.g. ["192.168.1.50", "192.168.1.51"]
_allowed_clients: Optional: only accept connections from these IPs (the Savant host). Empty = anyone on the LAN.
_app_aliases: Add or fix apps here. Name = what you put in the LAUNCH action, value = Android package (find with: firetvctl apps <ip>)
_live_tv: What LIVETV (and a quick double press of Home / the app's TV button) opens: key:<android keycode> or an app alias/package
